source_nature_en: Public retrospective HNSCC radiotherapy cohort with an official challenge split; clinical data from TCIA and processed pretreatment CT radiomics from ORCESTRA.
source_nature_zh: 公开的回顾性 HNSCC 放射治疗队列，具有官方挑战分区；临床数据来自 TCIA，预处理的治疗前 CT 影像组学特征来自 ORCESTRA。
population_scope_en: Frozen primary cohort restricted by the normalized exact invasive squamous-cell-carcinoma rule and the primary challenge split.
population_scope_zh: 冻结主队列，按标准化的浸润性鳞状细胞癌精确规则和官方 primary challenge split 限定。
modality_context_en: Clinical variables, gross tumour volume (GTV), and pretreatment CT radiomics.
modality_context_zh: 临床变量、大体肿瘤体积（GTV）和治疗前 CT 影像组学特征。
manuscript_role_zh: RADCURE 预设锁定回顾性测试。
time_origin_en: First radiotherapy fraction; OS duration is Last FU minus RT Start.
time_origin_zh: 首次放疗时间；OS 时长为 Last FU 减 RT Start。
prohibited_wording: prospective validation; universal external validation; radiomics-specific biological validation

source_nature_en: Public retrospective surgically treated HNSCC cohort with official distribution-shift splits and structured clinical, pathological, blood, and pre-extracted TMA data.
source_nature_zh: 公开的回顾性手术治疗 HNSCC 队列，具有官方分布偏移分区，并包含结构化临床、病理、血液和预提取 TMA 数据。
population_scope_en: All 763 frozen eligible patients in the source cohort; the official OOD split supplies the held-out Phase 6 test.
population_scope_zh: 源队列中全部 763 例冻结合格患者；官方 OOD 分区提供 Phase 6 留出测试。
modality_context_en: Clinical/pathological variables, baseline blood measurements, and TMA cell-density features.
modality_context_zh: 临床/病理变量、基线血液测量和 TMA 细胞密度特征。
development_role_en: Separate training (n=489) and calibration (n=122) partitions from the official development set.
manuscript_role_zh: HANCOCK 预设回顾性 OOD 测试。
time_origin_en: Diagnosis to last information or death, in days, following the source data dictionary.
time_origin_zh: 从诊断到最后信息日期或死亡日期，以天计。
required_qualifier_zh: 预设回顾性 OOD 测试
prohibited_wording: prospective validation; generic external validation without OOD role; independent institutional validation

source_nature_en: Public retrospective TCGA primary-tumour HNSCC cohort with open clinical data and RNA-sequencing expression profiles.
source_nature_zh: 公开的回顾性 TCGA 原发肿瘤 HNSCC 队列，包含开放临床数据和 RNA 测序表达谱。
population_scope_en: Expression/clinical-overlap cases; one unresolved OS duration was excluded from usable endpoint analyses.
population_scope_zh: 表达谱与临床数据重叠的病例；1 例 OS 时长无法解析，从可用终点分析中排除。
modality_context_en: Clinical variables and primary-tumour RNA-seq transcriptomics.
modality_context_zh: 临床变量和原发肿瘤 RNA-seq 转录组数据。
manuscript_role_en: TCGA-HNSC transcriptomic development and calibration cohort
manuscript_role_zh: TCGA-HNSC 转录组开发与校准队列。
time_origin_en: For deceased cases, nonnegative days_to_death; for living cases, the maximum available follow-up day.
time_origin_zh: 死亡病例采用非负 days_to_death；存活病例采用可得的最长随访时间。
required_qualifier_en: transcriptomic development and calibration only; no independent Phase 6 test
required_qualifier_zh: 仅用于转录组开发与校准；无独立 Phase 6 测试
prohibited_wording: TCGA-HNSC external validation; TCGA-HNSC locked test; Phase 6 validation cohort

source_nature_en: Public retrospective GEO microarray cohort used for outcome-independent cross-platform transcriptomic transfer.
source_nature_zh: 公开的回顾性 GEO 微阵列队列，用于结局独立的跨平台转录组转移。
population_scope_en: Frozen eligibility: primary tumour, no distant metastasis, and non-palliative treatment.
population_scope_zh: 冻结纳入条件：原发肿瘤、无远处转移且非姑息性治疗。
modality_context_en: Clinical variables and microarray transcriptomics under cross-platform transfer.
modality_context_zh: 临床变量和跨平台转移情境下的微阵列转录组数据。
development_role_en: None; outcomes were excluded from development, preprocessing, feature selection, tuning, calibration, and gate thresholds.
manuscript_role_en: GSE65858 prespecified retrospective cross-platform external test
manuscript_role_zh: GSE65858 预设回顾性跨平台外部测试。
time_origin_en: Overall-survival follow-up time supplied by the frozen GEO adapter and expressed in days.
time_origin_zh: 冻结 GEO 适配器提供的总生存随访时间，以天表示。
required_qualifier_zh: 预设回顾性跨平台外部测试
prohibited_wording: prospective validation; universal transportability; outcome-guided harmonization or recalibration

source_nature_en: Public retrospective GEO microarray cohort restricted to HPV-negative oral squamous cell carcinoma.
source_nature_zh: 公开的回顾性 GEO 微阵列队列，限定为 HPV 阴性口腔鳞状细胞癌。
population_scope_en: HPV-negative oral squamous cell carcinoma only; all source Dead categories count as all-cause OS events.
population_scope_zh: 仅包含 HPV 阴性口腔鳞状细胞癌；源数据中所有 Dead 类别均计为全因 OS 事件。
modality_context_en: Microarray transcriptomics in a restricted HPV-negative OSCC sensitivity setting.
modality_context_zh: 限定 HPV 阴性 OSCC 敏感性情境下的微阵列转录组数据。
development_role_en: None; outcomes were excluded from development and tuning.
manuscript_role_en: GSE41613 restricted retrospective HPV-negative OSCC sensitivity analysis
manuscript_role_zh: GSE41613 限定回顾性 HPV 阴性 OSCC 敏感性分析。
time_origin_en: Source follow-up in months converted as months multiplied by 30.4375 days.
time_origin_zh: 源随访月数按月数乘以 30.4375 转换为天数。
required_qualifier_en: restricted retrospective HPV-negative OSCC sensitivity analysis
required_qualifier_zh: 限定回顾性 HPV 阴性 OSCC 敏感性分析
prohibited_wording: validation cohort; general HNSCC external validation; independent confirmation

manuscript_display_name_zh: inner_hancock（已知重叠的 HANCOCK 模拟）
source_nature_en: Known-overlap workflow and bias simulation assembled from HANCOCK-like records; it contains development/calibration/test overlap by design.
source_nature_zh: 由类 HANCOCK 记录组建的已知重叠工作流程与偏倚模拟；按设计包含开发/校准/测试重叠。
population_scope_en: Simulation-only population with known overlap; not an independent patient cohort.
population_scope_zh: 仅用于模拟的已知重叠人群；不是独立患者队列。
modality_context_en: HANCOCK-like clinical/pathological, blood, and TMA features.
modality_context_zh: 类 HANCOCK 的临床/病理、血液和 TMA 特征。
development_role_en: Not applicable to the current manuscript.
manuscript_role_en: Known-overlap workflow and bias simulation; not validation
manuscript_role_zh: 已知重叠工作流程与偏倚模拟；不是验证。
time_origin_en: Inherited simulation endpoint semantics; not for current main-text reporting.
time_origin_zh: 沿用模拟终点语义；不用于当前正文报告。
required_qualifier_en: known-overlap workflow and bias simulation; not validation; Supplement only if separately approved
required_qualifier_zh: 已知重叠工作流程与偏倚模拟；不是验证；仅在另行批准时进入 Supplement
prohibited_wording: independent validation; private validation; institutional validation; external validation; main-text cohort
